name: pciconfig_write
synopsis: int pciconfig_write(unsigned long bus, unsigned long dfn, unsigned long off, unsigned long len, unsigned char *buf);
description: Writes data from a buffer to a specified offset in a PCI device's configuration space. This function is typically handled by the kernel and should not be used directly in user space unless necessary.

parameters.name: off
parameters.description: The offset in the configuration space

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of data to write

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: The buffer containing the data to write

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error
